name: shell-spline-wall
why: A turned cup with a spline wall, shell(1) with round corners: refused before at the volume identity's 1e-6 tolerance, which is under the integral's own 2e-6 noise on a revolved B-spline wall (1645.289 against 1645.300 mm3). The wall is sampled over the cavity's faces now and reads 1 mm, and measure_wall_thickness agrees.
